question: How did the teachers and disciples contribute to the illumination accomplished by the author?
premises: Others acted in relation to the author.
Their action provided some basis or impetus.
The author illumined this work as a result.
inference: Through what they did for him, the author was able to illumine this work.
uncertainties: The exact nature of their contribution is unspecified.
plain_english: They did something for me; then this was illumined by me.
